items.title: Notifications: ambiguous 'Resolved' button squeezed the fix steps on phones
items.detail: Open items showed a button labelled 'Resolved' in a right-hand column, leaving the How-to-fix box narrow at phone width. Button renamed 'Mark resolved' and moved below the card on phones.

items.title: Queue: publish time cut off on phones
items.detail: The meta line (template · category · publish time) was truncated at phone width, hiding the time. It now wraps and the time stays whole.

items.title: Sample data: thumbnails for the new story templates 404, 12 smoke tests red
items.detail: cf14172 switched the sample templates to short_story/long_story but public/sample/ only holds the retired templates' art, so every page with a thumbnail logged a 404 console error. The sample store now borrows a retired template's art for short_story and gives long_story no sample art (as the DB store does). New smoke test: no broken images on Overview, Queue, Videos, Templates.

items.title: Templates: on phones the Long story card's 16:9 player squeezes the text column
items.detail: At 390 px the landscape poster takes about half the card width, so the id line wraps ('long videos') and the description is cut off. Stack the player above the text on phones for landscape templates.

items.title: Video page: 5 of the 6 narrator voices shown as '(voice)'
items.detail: The Voiceover row only recognised Hindi-coded Kokoro ids (hf_/hm_), so every American voice the improver now rotates in (af_heart, af_bella, am_michael, am_fenrir, am_puck) read e.g. 'On · Bella (voice)'. It now reads accent and gender from the id: 'On · Bella (American, female)'. Sample data uses American voices too; new smoke test.

items.title: Overview: 'Since you last looked' line
items.detail: Remember the last visit per browser and show one line at the top: new videos queued, uploads scheduled, failures and new notifications since then. The owner checks twice a day; this answers 'what changed?' without scanning every card. Glanceable change summaries are the common thread in current ops-dashboard guidance (Cloudscape service dashboards, DesignRush 2026).

items.title: Overview on phones: 'Made today' card sits alone in a half-empty row
items.detail: At 390 px the five stat cards wrap 2-2-1, leaving the last card next to empty space. Let the last odd card span the full row (or fold 'Made today' into the Backlog card) so the top of the page is one tidy block.

items.title: Calendar: queued long videos planned into Short slots
items.detail: Planned entries used only the daily Short times and both formats' queues together, so the sample's two long videos showed at 07:07/12:37/19:07 instead of 20:07 on Tue/Thu/Sat, and trend slots never appeared. Calendar now uses the Queue page's posting plan per format.

items.title: Calendar: tell long videos from Shorts at a glance
items.detail: Content calendars colour or label entries by channel/format. A small 'Long' tag (text, not colour alone) on long entries lets the owner see the week's two long uploads without opening each day.

items.title: Calendar: show slots nothing is ready for
items.detail: The posting plan already knows the first empty slot. Showing it as a dashed 'Nothing ready' entry makes a running-dry backlog visible on the calendar, not just on the Queue page.

items.title: Video page: a due slot read as 'minutes ago'
items.detail: The queue's first Short showed '34m ago, if the queue order holds' while the Queue page said it was uploading now. It now reads 'Due now: this slot is open', the same posting plan state the Queue page uses.

items.title: Overview: Backlog card's 'days of uploads' counts long videos as Shorts
items.detail: The card divides every queued video (long ones too) by the daily Short slots, so 10 Shorts + 2 long videos show '≈ 4 days' while the Queue page says about 3 days of Shorts. The fix is one line, but that line names a guarded schedule setting, so the guard blocks the dashboard agent from changing it. Left for the auditor or the owner: use the Queue page's runway('short', …) on that card.

items.title: Agents and video page: tab labels wrapped and were clipped on phones
items.detail: On phones 'Experiments (1)', 'Topic feed (1)' and 'Merge log' wrapped to two lines inside the fixed-height tab bar, cutting off '(1)' and 'log'. Tabs now stay on one line and the row scrolls sideways. Smoke test 'section tabs keep their labels on one line'.

items.title: Agents: data audit badge read '1 warnings'
items.detail: The badge now counts in the right number ('0 errors · 1 warning'). Smoke test 'data audit badge counts in the right number'.

items.title: Notifications: Resolve all closed setting proposals without a decision
items.detail: A proposal has no 'Mark resolved' button because it needs Approve or Decline, but 'Resolve all' swept it into Resolved undecided, where it could no longer be approved. Resolve all now skips proposals. Smoke test 'resolve all leaves setting proposals for a decision'.

items.title: Agents and video page: show that the tab row scrolls on phones
items.detail: The tab rows now scroll sideways on phones with no scrollbar. A soft fade on the edge with more tabs (design-system guides recommend it where browsers hide scrollbars) tells the owner there is a 'Merge log' tab off-screen.

items.title: Notifications: Undo on the 'Resolve all' toast
items.detail: Notification-centre guides agree a mark-all action must be predictable and easy to undo. An Undo button in the toast that reopens exactly the items just resolved saves a trip to 'recently resolved' after a mis-tap on the phone.
